pendingLifecycleControls.name: live-descendant-cap-exceeded
pendingLifecycleControls.setup: Create more than 256 simultaneously live descendants inside the exclusively owned leaf; keep them live until cleanup observes the cap.

pendingLifecycleControls.name: creating-thread-exit-host-alive
pendingLifecycleControls.setup: Launch the wrapper from a short-lived host thread, retire that thread while the host and solver stay alive, then separately end the host process.
